reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

Thanks for flagging this. I checked with Access Bank directly rather than relying on our internal status, and the bank has confirmed that transfer TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000) was actually successful and credited to your account 0234567891 on 21 November at 14:02.

Our system was showing it as failed in error — no resend is needed, as that would result in a duplicate payment.

If the ₦250,000 still isn't visible in your account, please check with your bank using this confirmation reference from the transfer session: 000014261121140211000088. They should be able to trace it with that.

Do let me know if you don't see it and we'll take it further.

Best regards,
Mama's Kitchen Operations
